verdict.rationale: Linear's first-party changelog covers all three parts of the story for initiatives. A team can be assigned to lead an initiative, making clear who drives the work. Initiatives have statuses, including newly added Proposed and Canceled. A Priority field shows which initiatives matter most. The homepage frames initiatives as a core planning object. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of initiative tracking, and fuller documentation of the complete status lifecycle beyond the changelog snippets.
